items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: And it wasn't Dixieland as we see it, because trad jazz included Lips Page on trumpet many times

ctx.x: Yes, he had come later. He'd gotten there in the '40s, the mid-'40s or close to the mid-'40s, he'd come to New York. And he'd started a show called This Is Jazz. So it was a jazz boiling pot at that time, and the only kind of jazz there was talk about was trad jazz, traditional jazz. And although it wasn't Dixieland as we see it, because trad

jazz included Lips Page on trumpet many times, and it included Harlem piano, so it was -- we were using the word with a fairly wide net. It wasn't a narrow -- and there were jazz aficionados that would call us a little bit beyond what it should be.
